routes.heading: Roles
routes.caption: Review the access included in each role.

routes.heading: Document processing
routes.caption: Review document-processing work that needs attention.

personas.name: Financial Advisor
personas.opening: Working with an assigned customer's shared information

routes.heading: My Customers
routes.caption: Open an assigned customer and review information they agreed to share.

personas.boundary: A customer appears only while role, assignment and permission to share are current.
personas.closing: Reviewed an assigned customer and the governed advisory controls.
personas.nonclaim: The Advisor view is read-only unless a supported professional action is explicitly recorded.

personas.name: DSA / Case Manager
personas.opening: Picking up and managing a customer assistance case

routes.heading: Cases
routes.caption: Review submitted cases and the explicit Accept case action.

personas.boundary: Accepting a case does not reveal the customer's financial information.
personas.closing: Reviewed the case queue, state and safe ownership boundary.
personas.nonclaim: The recording does not create or expose customer financial access.

personas.name: Lender Professional
personas.opening: Reviewing an assigned application and its documents

routes.heading: Applications to Review
routes.caption: Review required documents and the human decision controls.

personas.boundary: Only assigned applications are shown; Monergy does not make the lending decision.
personas.closing: Reviewed an assigned application and its decision history.
personas.nonclaim: No automated lending decision or external verification is claimed.

personas.name: Financial Professional

routes.heading: Financial Reviews
routes.caption: Inspect assigned sources, professional notes and certification controls.

personas.boundary: Only assigned reviews with current customer permission are available.
personas.closing: Reviewed source-linked information and professional conclusion controls.
personas.nonclaim: The recording does not imply statutory audit or tax certification.

personas.name: Property Valuer
personas.opening: Reviewing an assigned property and recording controls

routes.heading: Property Valuations
routes.caption: Review property details, supporting documents and valuation history.

personas.boundary: A professional valuation remains distinct from customer-reported information.
personas.closing: Reviewed the assigned property and professional valuation controls.
personas.nonclaim: Monergy calculations are not represented as a professional valuation.

personas.name: Legal Advisor

routes.heading: Legal Reviews
routes.caption: Review the matter, its documents and human-authored outcome controls.

personas.boundary: The Legal Advisor owns the recorded finding; Monergy does not generate legal advice.
personas.closing: Reviewed an assigned matter and its review history.
personas.nonclaim: No external filing, signature, court submission or AI legal advice is claimed.

personas.name: Operations Support
personas.opening: Safely reviewing processing tasks that need attention

routes.heading: Tasks needing attention
routes.caption: Inspect a task, its attempt history and available recovery actions.

personas.boundary: Customer financial information and professional decisions stay hidden.
personas.closing: Reviewed task status, history and safe recovery controls.
personas.nonclaim: Raw infrastructure diagnostics are intentionally outside this workspace.

personas.name: Platform Administrator

routes.heading: System status
routes.caption: Review system availability, release readiness and operational history.

personas.boundary: Platform Administration does not enter organization or customer workspaces.
personas.closing: Reviewed system status, blockers and operational-note controls.
personas.nonclaim: LOCAL readiness is not Production or business acceptance.
